facts.fact: 那辆 Sundancer 房车是八十年代初出厂的轻型露营车，后被改造成巡游花车。
facts.anchor: At least that’s what it had been from the factory, three and a half decades ago.

facts.fact: 车主 Mooch Lomas 出借房车的条件：不抽烟、她 43 岁嫌自己太老不开车、要在明尼苏达停一站取东西。
facts.anchor: Mooch’s shrugging terms for the use of her precious RV were, first, no smoking, because she didn’t like her hair to smell like that, second, she was too old to drive—how was forty-three too old?—and, third, they make a stop in Minnesota to pick something up for her.

facts.fact: 房车里的越野摩托车是 Mooch 幼子 Conrad 的纪念——他在明尼苏达尝试当特技演员时身亡。
facts.anchor: it was a memorial for Mooch’s youngest son, who’d died out in Minnesota trying to make it as a stuntman.

facts.fact: 司机 Christian Two Bulls（Seine 侄女的独子）穿着神父装，随身带着从不离手的圣经。
facts.anchor: Christian Two Bulls in that priest getup he wore like a costume, one hand carrying the bible he’d never let go of

facts.fact: Seine 给 Nate 剃头，说这是「重置」——失去某人后你已不再是原来的自己，不如从头活起。
facts.anchor: “This is like a reset for you,” she told him, his hair collecting on the sheet.

facts.fact: Seine 告诉 Nate 他今天出院，并说他就是第四个人。
facts.anchor: “You’re out as of today, I mean,” she told him, tapping the silver watch on her wrist.

facts.fact: Nate 问「那所寄宿学校到底在哪」，说明他已经决定加入。
facts.anchor: “Where even is this… this boarding school?” he asked, which meant she had him. He was in.

facts.fact: Nate 担心带不回 Sebby；Seine 只轻声说「但有可能」。
facts.anchor: “But it might,” Seine said back, just as quiet.
